propositions: make amend-msg preserves Change-Id but silently drops Signed-off-by when the replacement message file omits it, because only Change-Id is explicitly read from HEAD and re-attached while everything else comes from FILE wholesale

the tool's docstring and rationale acknowledge that Signed-off-by is a required trailer in the same message block as Change-Id, yet the implementation drops it through the same mechanism it was built to prevent for Change-Id
no CI gate or validation catches the missing Signed-off-by after amend, so the loss surfaces later or not at all despite CONTRIBUTING.md requiring the sign-off
the fix must preserve all existing Signed-off-by trailers from HEAD only when the new message file does not supply one, and respect any sign-offs in the file itself without duplication
